title: Community Seed Exchange Notice
prompt: The Meadowbrook Library is opening a seed exchange corner this spring. Visitors may take up to three packets of vegetable or flower seeds at no charge. If you have extra seeds from your garden, please bring them in labeled envelopes. Our volunteers will explain planting basics every Saturday at eleven. The exchange is located beside the reading lounge on the ground floor. We hope this small project will help more neighbors grow something at home.
sample_answer: The Meadowbrook Library is opening a seed exchange corner / this spring. / Visitors may take up to three packets / of vegetable or flower seeds / at no charge. / If you have extra seeds from your garden, / please bring them in labeled envelopes. / Our volunteers will explain planting basics / every Saturday at eleven. / The exchange is located beside the reading lounge / on the ground floor. / We hope this small project will help more neighbors / grow something at home.
tips_md:
**Đọc thông báo trao đổi hạt giống:**
- Nhấn **three packets**, **at no charge** và **Saturday at eleven** vì đây là số lượng, chi phí và giờ hướng dẫn.
- Tập âm /dʒ/ trong **vegetable** và âm cuối của **packets**, **seeds**.
- Ngắt hơi sau mệnh đề điều kiện **If you have extra seeds from your garden**; kết thúc bằng giọng khích lệ.

title: New Signs Along the Riverside Trail
prompt: Starting this weekend, visitors to the Riverside Trail will notice new direction signs at each major crossing. Blue arrows point toward the lake, while orange arrows lead back to the visitor center. The trail remains open during installation, but a short section near the wooden bridge may be temporarily narrow. Cyclists should slow down and give way to people walking. Thank you for helping everyone enjoy the trail safely.
sample_answer: Starting this weekend, / visitors to the Riverside Trail will notice new direction signs / at each major crossing. / Blue arrows point toward the lake, / while orange arrows lead back to the visitor center. / The trail remains open during installation, / but a short section near the wooden bridge / may be temporarily narrow. / Cyclists should slow down / and give way to people walking. / Thank you for helping everyone enjoy the trail safely.

**Đọc hướng dẫn trên đường đi bộ:**
- Làm rõ sự đối lập **blue arrows → lake** và **orange arrows → visitor center**.
- Nhấn cụm cảnh báo **temporarily narrow** và động từ **slow down**, **give way**.
- Giữ âm cuối của **signs**, **crossings**, **cyclists** và hạ giọng ở câu cảm ơn.

title: Recycling Instructions at the Night Market
prompt: Welcome to the Lantern Night Market. To keep the square clean, please separate your waste before leaving. Green bins are for food scraps, and white bins are for cups and dry packaging. Volunteers in yellow vests can help you find the correct collection point. Most food stalls close at nine thirty, but the information desk stays open until ten. We appreciate your cooperation and hope you have a pleasant evening.
sample_answer: Welcome to the Lantern Night Market. / To keep the square clean, / please separate your waste before leaving. / Green bins are for food scraps, / and white bins are for cups and dry packaging. / Volunteers in yellow vests / can help you find the correct collection point. / Most food stalls close at nine thirty, / but the information desk stays open until ten. / We appreciate your cooperation / and hope you have a pleasant evening.
tips_md:
**Luyện đọc hướng dẫn phân loại rác:**
- Nhấn cặp **green bins / food scraps** và **white bins / cups and dry packaging**.
- Phân biệt **nine thirty** (quầy thức ăn) với **ten** (bàn thông tin).
- Luyện nối âm trong **separate your waste** và đọc rõ /s/ ở **vests**, **stalls**.

title: Self-Guided Audio Walk Launch
prompt: Explore the old town at your own pace with our new audio walking guide. The route includes eight short stories about local buildings, crafts, and public spaces. You can start at any marked stop and listen using your phone and headphones. Each recording lasts about three minutes. Printed route maps are available at the welcome kiosk until four o'clock. Please remember to look around carefully when crossing streets.
sample_answer: Explore the old town at your own pace / with our new audio walking guide. / The route includes eight short stories / about local buildings, crafts, and public spaces. / You can start at any marked stop / and listen using your phone and headphones. / Each recording lasts about three minutes. / Printed route maps are available at the welcome kiosk / until four o'clock. / Please remember to look around carefully / when crossing streets.

**Giới thiệu ứng dụng thuyết minh:**
- Nhấn **eight short stories**, **three minutes** và **until four o'clock**.
- Chia câu có danh sách **buildings, crafts, and public spaces** thành ba nhịp đều.
- Câu cuối là lưu ý an toàn nên nói chậm, rõ cụm **crossing streets**.

title: Quiet Room at the Learning Conference
prompt: Participants attending the Learning Futures Conference may use the quiet room on the second floor. The space is designed for anyone who needs a short break from busy sessions. Please silence your phone, avoid conversations, and limit your visit to twenty minutes when others are waiting. Water is available just outside the door. The room will be open from eight in the morning until five each day of the conference.
sample_answer: Participants attending the Learning Futures Conference / may use the quiet room on the second floor. / The space is designed for anyone / who needs a short break from busy sessions. / Please silence your phone, / avoid conversations, / and limit your visit to twenty minutes / when others are waiting. / Water is available just outside the door. / The room will be open from eight in the morning / until five / each day of the conference.

**Đọc thông báo không gian yên tĩnh:**
- Đánh dấu các quy tắc **silence**, **avoid**, **limit** để nhấn các động từ song song.
- Chú ý **twenty minutes** và khung giờ **eight ... until five**.
- Giữ giọng nhẹ nhàng, tránh nhấn quá mạnh trong câu giải thích mục đích của phòng.

title: Citizen Weather Data Workshop
prompt: Would you like to understand the weather in your neighborhood? Join our free observation workshop on Sunday afternoon. An instructor will show participants how to measure rainfall, record temperatures, and report unusual conditions. Basic equipment will be provided, and no previous experience is necessary. The workshop begins at two in the community classroom and ends at four. Please wear comfortable shoes because part of the session takes place outdoors.
sample_answer: Would you like to understand the weather / in your neighborhood? / Join our free observation workshop / on Sunday afternoon. / An instructor will show participants / how to measure rainfall, / record temperatures, / and report unusual conditions. / Basic equipment will be provided, / and no previous experience is necessary. / The workshop begins at two / in the community classroom / and ends at four. / Please wear comfortable shoes / because part of the session takes place outdoors.

**Luyện đọc lời mời tham gia workshop:**
- Lên giọng ở câu hỏi mở đầu rồi nhấn **free**, **Sunday afternoon**, **two**, **four**.
- Tập trọng âm trong **observation**, **temperature**, **equipment**, **necessary**.
- Ngắt hơi giữa các hoạt động đo mưa, ghi nhiệt độ và báo cáo hiện tượng.

title: Office Bicycle Storage Instructions
prompt: Employees who cycle to work can now use the covered bicycle area behind Building C. To enter, scan your staff card at the gate and choose an empty numbered rack. Personal locks are required because the company does not provide them. Please avoid leaving helmets or bags on the floor where they may block the walkway. Report any damaged racks to facilities through the internal service form. The bicycle area is accessible every day.
sample_answer: Employees who cycle to work / can now use the covered bicycle area / behind Building C. / To enter, / scan your staff card at the gate / and choose an empty numbered rack. / Personal locks are required / because the company does not provide them. / Please avoid leaving helmets or bags on the floor / where they may block the walkway. / Report any damaged racks to facilities / through the internal service form. / The bicycle area is accessible every day.

**Đọc quy định bãi gửi xe:**

- Nhấn **behind Building C** và **Personal locks are required**.
- Tập phân biệt **racks**, **locks**, **bags** để không bỏ âm cuối.

- Câu cuối có sự đối lập giữa miễn phí và cần đặt chỗ; nghỉ ngắn trước **but**.

title: School Lost Property Reminder
prompt: Parents and students are reminded to check the lost property shelf near the main office before the end of term. Unclaimed water bottles, jackets, and lunch boxes will be displayed there until Friday afternoon. Items with names will be returned directly to their owners whenever possible. Any remaining clothing will be donated to a local charity next week. Please contact the school office if you believe you have lost something valuable.
sample_answer: Parents and students are reminded / to check the lost property shelf near the main office / before the end of term. / Unclaimed water bottles, jackets, and lunch boxes / will be displayed there until Friday afternoon. / Items with names / will be returned directly to their owners / whenever possible. / Any remaining clothing / will be donated to a local charity next week. / Please contact the school office / if you believe you have lost something valuable.

**Đọc thông báo đồ thất lạc:**

- Ngắt hơi trong danh sách **water bottles, jackets, and lunch boxes**.
- Đọc rõ âm /d/ trong **reminded**, âm /t/ trong **contact** và phụ âm cuối **items**.

title: Solar Lighting Inspection Notice
prompt: Maintenance workers will inspect the solar-powered lights in Parkview Square on Wednesday morning. Some pathways may be closed for a few minutes while equipment is tested. - Giữ giọng nghiêm túc ở cảnh báo **do not move safety cones**; ngắt hơi sau mệnh đề **If you notice...**.

title: Local History Podcast Call for Stories
prompt: Our community radio team is collecting personal stories for a new local history podcast. We welcome memories about neighborhood traditions, familiar shops, and changes to public places. You do not need recording experience to take part. A producer will guide you through a relaxed interview lasting approximately twenty minutes. Stories will be reviewed with participants before publication. If you would like to contribute, send a short description of your memory by the end of the month.
sample_answer: Our community radio team is collecting personal stories / for a new local history podcast. / We welcome memories / about neighborhood traditions, familiar shops, / and changes to public places. / You do not need recording experience / to take part. / A producer will guide you / through a relaxed interview lasting approximately twenty minutes. / Stories will be reviewed with participants / before publication. / If you would like to contribute, / send a short description of your memory / by the end of the month.

- Luyện nối âm **personal stories**, **recording experience** và trọng âm **publication**.
- Ngắt hơi hợp lý ở câu cuối sau **If you would like to contribute**; dùng giọng gần gũi.

title: Scanning Historical Photographs
prompt: TOEIC-style picture description. Describe the people, their actions, and the setting using only the details visible in the scene.
image_description: At a public library digitization table, a librarian wearing blue gloves is placing an old black-and-white photograph beneath a flatbed scanner. A second worker sits at a computer and checks the scanned image on a large monitor. Several labeled archival folders are stacked on the left side of the desk. A small desk lamp lights the work area, and closed storage cabinets line the wall behind them.
sample_answer: This picture shows two people working with historical photographs in a library. On the right, one worker is carefully placing an old photo on a scanner. Another person is checking a digital image on a monitor. There are labeled folders on the desk and storage cabinets in the background. Both workers appear focused on preserving the materials.
tips_md:
**Mô tả quy trình số hóa ảnh:**
- Mở bằng **a library digitization area**, sau đó nói hai hành động **is placing** và **is checking**.
- Phân biệt **scanner** là thiết bị quét và **monitor** là màn hình hiển thị.
- Chỉ dùng **appear focused** như nhận xét nhẹ, tránh đoán ảnh thuộc về ai.

title: Counting Birds Near a Wetland

- Kết nối hành động bằng **while** và sử dụng **is looking**, **is writing**, **is pointing**.
- Tránh khẳng định loài chim khi hình chỉ cho thấy **white birds**.

title: Preparing a Hotel Breakfast Buffet

- Không tự suy ra tên khách sạn hay giờ mở cửa từ hình.

- Luyện giới từ **near**, **behind**, **on both sides of** để định vị vật thể.

title: A Community Electronics Repair Desk

title: IELTS Part 1 Practice: Places to Read
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1 practice. Answer each question about your own reading habits in a natural, conversational way.
1. Where do you usually go when you want to read quietly?
2. Has your favorite place for reading changed since you were a child?
3. Do you think public places should provide more areas for reading?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually read at a small desk near my bedroom window. There is enough natural light there, and I can concentrate without hearing the television.
Q2: Yes, definitely. When I was younger, I liked reading on the living room floor. These days I prefer a proper chair because I often take notes.
Q3: I think so. Even a few comfortable seats in a park or community center could encourage people to read during a break.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – nơi đọc sách:**
- Trả lời trực tiếp bằng địa điểm cụ thể rồi bổ sung một lý do có thật hoặc hợp lý.
- Với **Has ... changed?**, đối chiếu **when I was younger** và **these days**.
- Dùng ví dụ nhỏ như ghế ở công viên thay cho nhận định quá rộng về chính sách.

title: IELTS Part 1 Practice: Morning Routines
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1 practice. Respond to these questions about mornings.
1. What is the first thing you normally do after waking up?
2. Are your mornings different on weekends?
3. Is there a morning habit you would like to develop?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually open the curtains and drink some water before checking my messages. That simple routine helps me wake up gradually.
Q2: Yes. On weekdays I need to leave quite early, so breakfast is quick. At weekends I often cook something warm and spend longer at the table.
Q3: I would like to stretch for ten minutes every morning. I sit at a computer a lot, and I think a short movement break would help me feel more energetic.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – thói quen buổi sáng:**
- Dùng **usually**, **often**, **on weekdays**, **at weekends** để nêu tần suất rõ ràng.
- Câu hỏi 3 cần nói cả thói quen muốn tập và tác dụng mong đợi.
- Chia mỗi câu trả lời thành ý chính, chi tiết cá nhân, một lời giải thích ngắn.

title: IELTS Part 1 Practice: Photographs
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1 practice. Give personal answers to the following questions.
1. What kinds of things do you enjoy photographing?
2. Do you usually look at old photographs?
3. Would you rather print your favorite photographs or keep them on your phone?
sample_answer:
Q1: I like taking photos of ordinary street scenes, especially when the light changes in the late afternoon. They remind me of places I might otherwise forget.
Q2: I do, but only occasionally. When I find an old picture, I often remember a conversation or a funny moment from that day.
Q3: I prefer keeping most photos on my phone because they are easy to organize. However, I would print a few special ones to give to family members.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – ảnh và ký ức:**
- Với **what kinds of**, nêu một nhóm đối tượng có hình ảnh cụ thể.
- Phân biệt **occasionally** và **usually** để tránh mâu thuẫn tần suất.
- Ở lựa chọn in hay lưu điện thoại, nói một ưu điểm và thêm ngoại lệ tự nhiên nếu có.

title: IELTS Part 1 Practice: Home Cooking
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1 practice. Answer these questions about cooking.
1. Do you enjoy preparing meals at home?
2. Who taught you to cook your first dish?
3. What would you like to learn to make in the future?
sample_answer:
Q1: Yes, especially on evenings when I have enough time. Cooking helps me relax, and I can adjust the ingredients to suit my taste.
Q2: My older cousin showed me how to make a simple vegetable soup. I remember being surprised that such a basic recipe could taste so good.
Q3: I would love to learn how to bake bread. It takes patience, but I like the idea of making something from a few simple ingredients.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – nấu ăn:**
- Sử dụng **enjoy + V-ing** trong câu 1 và quá khứ đơn **showed me** ở câu 2.
- Nêu món ăn cụ thể để câu trả lời có cá tính, thay vì nói chung chung.
- Câu 3 dùng **would love to** rồi giải thích vì sao món đó hấp dẫn.

title: VSTEP Social Interaction: Helping Neighbors
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1-style social interaction. Answer each question with an explanation or example.
1. How well do you know the people living near you?
2. What is a simple way neighbors can help one another?
3. Would you join a neighborhood activity? Why?
sample_answer:
Q1: I know a few families in my building. We usually say hello in the hallway, and sometimes we talk about local events.
Q2: One simple way is to collect deliveries for someone who is away, provided they have agreed. It is a small favor that can save them trouble.
Q3: Yes, I would join a weekend clean-up. It would make the shared area nicer and give me a chance to meet people I do not know yet.
tips_md:
**VSTEP – giao tiếp về hàng xóm:**
- Đưa ra chi tiết gần gũi như hành lang hoặc buổi dọn vệ sinh để câu trả lời chân thật.
- Với hành động giúp đỡ, thêm điều kiện **provided they have agreed** để diễn đạt lịch sự.
- Kết hợp **would + V** khi trả lời về hoạt động giả định trong tương lai.

title: VSTEP Social Interaction: Family Occasions
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1-style social interaction. Speak about family occasions.
1. Which family occasion do you look forward to most?
2. How does your family usually prepare for it?
3. Have celebrations changed compared with a few years ago?
sample_answer:
Q1: I look forward to our yearly family dinner because relatives who live in different places can finally meet and catch up.
Q2: We share the tasks. Some people prepare food, others arrange seats, and the younger children help decorate the room.
Q3: Yes, a little. We now use a group chat to plan the meal, which makes organizing easier. However, we still try to spend the evening talking face to face.
tips_md:
**VSTEP – dịp sum họp gia đình:**
- Nói tên dịp hoặc hoạt động cụ thể, sau đó giải thích giá trị của việc gặp gỡ.
- Sử dụng **some ... others ...** để mô tả phân công chuẩn bị.
- Với câu hỏi thay đổi, đối chiếu cách lập kế hoạch hiện nay với hoạt động vẫn giữ nguyên.

title: VSTEP Social Interaction: Places for Children
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1-style social interaction. Answer the questions about outdoor spaces for children.
1. What kinds of places can children play in your area?
2. What makes a play area safe and enjoyable?
3. How could residents improve a small local playground?
sample_answer:
Q1: There are two neighborhood parks with open spaces and a few simple climbing structures. Families often visit them in the late afternoon.
Q2: I think good lighting, clean surfaces, and equipment suitable for different ages are important. Children also need room to move without crowding.
Q3: Residents could organize a clean-up and report broken equipment to the local office. Even adding a shaded bench for caregivers would make the playground more comfortable.
tips_md:
**VSTEP – không gian vui chơi:**
- Nêu ví dụ dễ hình dung trước khi chuyển sang tiêu chí an toàn.
- Liệt kê các yếu tố song song **lighting, clean surfaces, suitable equipment**.
- Dùng **could** để đưa đề xuất thực tế và tránh hứa hẹn thay chính quyền.

title: TOEIC Questions: Customer Feedback Preferences
prompt:
TOEIC Speaking-style questions. Imagine a company is surveying customers about feedback methods. Answer all three questions.
1. When did you last give feedback about a service?
2. Do you prefer filling out a short form or speaking to an employee?
3. What could a business do to encourage more useful customer feedback?
sample_answer:
Q1: Last month I completed a short survey after receiving a grocery delivery. I wanted to compliment the driver for arriving on time.
Q2: I usually prefer a short form because I can complete it whenever I have a moment. For urgent problems, I would speak to someone directly.
Q3: The business should ask a few specific questions and explain how feedback will be used. If customers see improvements, they may be more willing to respond again.
tips_md:
**TOEIC – trả lời khảo sát khách hàng:**
- Câu 1 dùng quá khứ đơn với mốc thời gian rõ.
- Câu 2 chọn một cách phản hồi rồi nêu trường hợp ngoại lệ.
- Câu 3 trình bày **specific questions → visible improvements → more responses** theo quan hệ nguyên nhân.

title: TOEIC Questions: Choosing Repair Services
prompt:
TOEIC Speaking-style survey. Answer the following three questions about repair services.
1. What was the last item you had repaired or tried to repair?
2. How do you decide whether a repair service is reliable?
3. Would you pay more for a service that provides a clear written repair estimate? Explain why.
sample_answer:
Q1: I recently had a desk fan repaired because it had stopped rotating properly. The technician replaced a small part, and it now works well.
Q2: I check whether the shop explains the problem clearly and offers a reasonable completion date. Recommendations from friends also help.
Q3: Yes, I would pay a little extra for a written estimate. It would show the expected cost and parts before the work starts, which could prevent misunderstandings.
tips_md:
**TOEIC – dịch vụ sửa chữa:**
- Dùng **had ... repaired** khi nhờ dịch vụ sửa đồ, tránh nhầm với tự sửa.
- Câu 2 nêu hai tiêu chí kiểm chứng được, như giải thích rõ và thời hạn.
- Câu 3 diễn đạt lợi ích của báo giá bằng **would show** và **could prevent**.

title: Workplace Interview: Handing Over a Task
prompt:
Workplace communication practice. You are being interviewed about how you pass unfinished work to a teammate. Answer each question.
1. What information do you include in a task handover?
2. How do you make sure the receiving person understands the next steps?
3. Tell me about a time when a clear handover prevented confusion.
sample_answer:
Q1: I include the current status, any decisions already made, outstanding issues, and the next deadline. I also link to the files the person will need.
Q2: I ask them to summarize the next action in their own words and invite questions. That is usually quicker than discovering a misunderstanding later.
Q3: During a small event, I handed over the guest list with marked late arrivals. The next volunteer knew exactly whom to expect, so check-in stayed organized.
tips_md:
**Giao tiếp công sở – bàn giao việc:**
- Liệt kê **status, decisions, issues, deadline** bằng nhịp rõ ràng.
- Câu 2 dùng cách xác nhận hai chiều, không chỉ nói **I send an email**.
- Câu 3 kể ngắn theo thứ tự **tình huống → hành động → kết quả**.

title: IT Interview: Explaining a Technical Change
prompt:
IT workplace speaking practice. Explain changes to someone without a technical background.
1. How would you explain a planned application update to customers?
2. What would you say if a customer asked whether their saved work would disappear?
3. How should a support team respond when users report an unexpected change afterward?
sample_answer:
Q1: I would start with what users will notice, when the update happens, and whether they need to take any action. I would avoid unnecessary technical terms.
Q2: I would check the verified release notes before answering. If their saved work is protected, I would say that clearly and explain any recommended backup step.
Q3: The team should acknowledge the report, collect the steps that caused the issue, and provide updates. If a workaround is available, it should be described in plain language.
tips_md:
**IT – giải thích thay đổi cho người dùng:**
- Mở đầu từ góc nhìn khách hàng **what will change, when, what to do**.
- Không cam kết dữ liệu an toàn khi chưa kiểm chứng; dùng **check verified release notes**.
- Câu 3 theo trình tự **acknowledge → collect steps → update → workaround**.

| Item | Collection Day | Collection Window | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desk lamp | Tuesday | 10:00 A.M.–12:00 P.M. | Ready |
| Coffee grinder | Wednesday | 1:00–3:00 P.M. | Ready |
| Portable fan | Thursday | 11:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M. | Awaiting part |
| Table radio | Friday | 2:00–4:00 P.M. | Ready |

Questions:
1. Where should customers collect repaired items?
2. Is the portable fan ready for collection on Thursday?
3. When can customers collect the coffee grinder and the table radio?
sample_answer:
Q1: Customers should collect their items at the Workshop Front Desk.
Q2: No. The portable fan is still awaiting a part, so it is not marked ready for Thursday collection.
Q3: The coffee grinder is ready for pickup on Wednesday between one and three in the afternoon. The table radio is ready on Friday between two and four. Both items have a ready status.
tips_md:
**Đọc bảng theo dõi sửa chữa:**
- Kiểm tra **Status** trước khi nói khách có thể nhận thiết bị.
- Phân biệt **Ready** với **Awaiting part**; tránh suy diễn thời điểm sửa xong.
- Câu 3 ghép đúng ngày, giờ, tên thiết bị và trả lời bằng câu đầy đủ.

title: TOEIC Opinion: Repair Events in Shopping Centers
prompt: TOEIC Speaking opinion practice. Some shopping centers invite local volunteers to run free repair advice events for small household items. Do you think these events are a good use of public space? Give reasons and an example.
sample_answer: I think repair advice events are an excellent use of shopping center space. First, people can learn whether an item has a simple problem before throwing it away. This could reduce waste and help families save money. Second, the events give local volunteers a chance to share practical skills. For example, a visitor might bring a broken desk lamp and learn how to check its plug safely. Even if a professional repair is still needed, the visitor will understand the problem better. I would support a monthly event as long as it has a clear safety policy and enough space.
tips_md:
**TOEIC – nêu ý kiến về sự kiện sửa đồ:**
- Trả lời **I think ...** trong câu đầu và phát triển hai lợi ích riêng.
- Ví dụ cần có đồ vật, hành động tư vấn và kết quả cụ thể.
- Nói **advice events** thay vì hứa mọi thiết bị đều được sửa miễn phí.

title: TOEIC Opinion: Shade at Outdoor Waiting Areas
prompt: TOEIC Speaking opinion practice. A city has a small budget to improve public waiting areas. Do you think adding shade and seating should be a priority? Support your answer with two reasons and an example.
sample_answer: Yes, I believe shade and seating should be a priority, especially where people wait for buses or community services. A covered area offers a more comfortable place during hot weather or light rain. Seats are also helpful for older people, parents with children, and anyone carrying heavy bags. For example, a busy bus stop near a health center might have only a narrow pavement. Adding a simple roof and several benches could make waiting much easier. I would start with the busiest locations and check whether the new furniture leaves enough room for people to pass safely.
tips_md:
**TOEIC – ưu tiên cải thiện không gian chờ:**
- Bám điều kiện **small budget** và nêu cách chọn điểm ưu tiên.
- Dùng một ví dụ cụ thể như điểm chờ xe buýt, sau đó nói tác động với người sử dụng.
- Kết thúc bằng yếu tố khả thi **busy locations** và lối đi an toàn.

title: IELTS Part 2: Learning from a Younger Person
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 long-turn practice. Describe a useful skill you learned from someone younger than you.
You should say:
- who the person was
- what skill they taught you
- how they explained it
and explain why you value that experience. Speak as a connected story rather than answering the bullet points separately.
sample_answer:
A useful skill I learned from someone younger was how to record and edit short videos on my phone. My neighbor's daughter, who was still at school, showed me the basics when I wanted to make a simple video about a community event. I had taken plenty of photos before, but I had never paid much attention to sound or the order of clips.

She began by asking what story I wanted to tell. Then she demonstrated how to hold the phone steadily, record a few seconds of natural sound, and trim unnecessary parts. What impressed me was her patience. Whenever I made a mistake, she explained the step again and let me try it myself.

Later that week, I used those techniques to create a two-minute video for our neighborhood group. It wasn't perfect, but people could follow the story easily. I value the experience because it reminded me that knowledge can come from anyone, regardless of age. It also made me more willing to ask questions instead of pretending I already know how everything works.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – kể trải nghiệm học kỹ năng:**
- Trong 60 giây chuẩn bị, ghi 4 từ khóa **person, skill, steps, lesson**.
- Kể theo quá khứ với **began**, **demonstrated**, **used**, rồi chuyển sang hiện tại khi rút bài học.
- Phát triển phần **why you value it** bằng cảm xúc và thay đổi trong cách học.
- Dành nhiều thời gian cho hành động cụ thể, tránh chỉ liệt kê các gạch đầu dòng.

title: IELTS Part 2: An Ordinary Object with Special Meaning
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 long-turn practice. Describe a simple object that you have kept for a long time.
You should say:
- what it is and how you got it
- where you keep it
- what memories you connect with it
and explain why it matters to you.
sample_answer:
One ordinary object I have kept for years is a small wooden ruler. My grandfather gave it to me when I was learning to draw straight lines for school projects. It has faded numbers and a tiny mark near one corner, so it is hardly something anyone would choose as a decoration.

I keep it in the top drawer of my desk, along with old notebooks and postcards. Sometimes I use it to mark the edge of a page, although I have newer rulers that are easier to read. Whenever I pick it up, I remember sitting at the kitchen table while my grandfather explained how to measure carefully instead of rushing through a task.

What makes the ruler special is the memory of his calm voice and the time he gave me. It also reminds me how small tools can be connected to important lessons. I don't think an object has to be expensive to be worth keeping. For me, this ruler represents patience, encouragement, and a part of my childhood that I still appreciate.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – tả vật gắn với ký ức:**
- Đi từ **đặc điểm → nguồn gốc → kỷ niệm → ý nghĩa** để bài có mạch truyện.
- Từ hữu ích gồm **faded**, **drawer**, **reminds me of**, **represents**.
- Mô tả ký ức bằng một tình huống nhỏ, chẳng hạn người thân chỉ cách đo.
- Tách giá trị tinh thần của món đồ khỏi giá tiền để kết luận sâu hơn.

title: IELTS Part 2: Solving a Problem as a Group
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 long-turn practice. Describe a time when you worked with other people to solve an unexpected problem.
You should say:
- what event or situation you were involved in
- what went wrong
- what each person did
and explain what you learned about working with a group.
sample_answer:
Last year, I helped a group of neighbors organize a small outdoor book exchange. We had collected dozens of books and arranged tables in the courtyard of our building. Just before the event began, dark clouds appeared and heavy rain started falling. The tables were covered, but the books were still at risk of getting wet.

At first, everyone looked surprised. Then one neighbor suggested moving the exchange into the entrance hall. Two people carried the boxes inside while I helped move the tables and put signs near the courtyard. Another volunteer sent a message to registered visitors with the new location. Within about fifteen minutes, the event was ready to start again.

A few visitors arrived late, but most found us without difficulty, and we still exchanged plenty of books. I was pleased because no single person had to solve everything. We listened to one clear suggestion, divided the tasks, and kept communicating. Since then, I've learned to focus on the next useful action when plans change instead of spending too long discussing the problem.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – kể cách xử lý sự cố:**
- Dùng bố cục **initial plan → unexpected rain → team response → result → lesson**.
- Các từ nối **just before**, **at first**, **then**, **within fifteen minutes**, **since then** giúp kể tự nhiên.
- Nêu đóng góp của ít nhất hai người và nhiệm vụ bản thân.
- Kết luận bằng bài học về phối hợp, không chỉ nói sự kiện thành công.

title: IELTS Part 3: Preserving Traditional Crafts
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion practice. Explore both questions in one extended response.
1. Why do some traditional practical skills become less common over time?
2. What can communities do to help younger people become interested in those skills?
sample_answer:
I think traditional skills sometimes become less common because everyday life changes. If people can buy a replacement cheaply, they may not spend time learning how to repair or make something. Another reason is that skilled craftspeople may have few opportunities to teach beginners.

Communities could make these skills more visible through short workshops and demonstrations. For example, a local center could invite a basket maker to show students how raw materials become a finished product. Participants could try one simple step rather than just watch. Schools might also connect craft activities with history lessons, so students understand their cultural context.

However, I don't think preservation means asking everyone to work in an old-fashioned way. The aim should be to keep valuable knowledge available and give interested people a chance to learn it.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – phân tích nguyên nhân và giải pháp:**
- Trả lời lần lượt **why skills decline** rồi **how communities can help**.
- Dùng ví dụ một nghề thủ công và một hoạt động học có thể thực hiện.
- Thêm ý cân bằng **preservation does not require everyone to work traditionally**.
- Luyện từ **craftspeople**, **demonstrations**, **cultural context**.

title: IELTS Part 3: Designing Flexible Public Spaces
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion practice. Give a reasoned response to both questions.
1. Why might a city need public spaces that can be used for different activities?
2. What problems can arise when many groups want to use the same space?
sample_answer:
Flexible public spaces can help cities make better use of limited land. A square might host a morning exercise group, a small market on weekends, and outdoor performances in the evening. This variety allows residents of different ages to benefit from the same location, and it can make an area feel lively.

The challenge is that different activities may conflict. A music event, for instance, could disturb someone who wants a quiet place to read. Crowded events may also affect access for people who simply need to walk through the square. I think managers should publish a clear schedule, provide quiet times, and keep important paths open.

Public consultation matters too, because local residents know how the space is used from day to day. Flexibility works best when rules are understandable and fair.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – đánh giá lợi ích và xung đột:**
- Nêu nhiều cách sử dụng cùng một địa điểm, sau đó chỉ ra mâu thuẫn cụ thể.
- Dùng cấu trúc **might ... but ...** để phát triển góc nhìn hai chiều.
- Giải pháp phải gắn với vấn đề, như lịch công khai, giờ yên tĩnh và lối đi.
- Tránh khẳng định một cách sử dụng phù hợp cho mọi khu dân cư.

title: IELTS Part 3: Technology and Independent Learning
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion practice. Address both questions with examples.
1. How have digital tools changed the way adults learn new skills?
2. Why might some learners still benefit from lessons with a teacher?
sample_answer:
Digital tools have made learning much more flexible for adults. Someone who works full time can watch a short explanation in the evening, repeat difficult sections, and practice without traveling to a classroom. For example, a person learning basic spreadsheet skills can follow a tutorial and test each step on their own computer.

However, independent learning can be frustrating when the learner doesn't know why something went wrong. A teacher can identify a misunderstanding, give focused feedback, and suggest a suitable next activity. Learning with others can also create motivation and a sense of progress.

I think the best arrangement depends on the skill and the person. Digital materials are particularly useful for repetition, while a teacher can help with judgment, questions, and tasks that require detailed feedback.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – so sánh cách học:**
- Trình bày ưu điểm của công cụ số bằng ví dụ thao tác cụ thể.
- Giải thích vai trò giáo viên qua **feedback**, **misunderstanding**, **motivation**.
- Kết luận có điều kiện **depends on the skill and the person** để tránh tuyệt đối hóa.
- Dùng từ nối **however**, **also**, **while** để thể hiện so sánh.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Choosing a Job Club Activity
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2 problem-solving practice. A community center wants to help recent graduates prepare for their first job. It can offer only one new activity this month. Choose the best option and explain why.
Option A: a weekly mentoring session with local employees.
Option B: a library of short recorded interview tips.
Option C: a one-day panel with company representatives.
Compare the options and justify your recommendation.
sample_answer:
I would choose the weekly mentoring session with local employees. Recent graduates often have different questions about finding work, and a mentor can respond to their individual situations. For example, someone applying for a customer support role may need help explaining teamwork, while another person may need advice on organizing a portfolio. Regular meetings also allow participants to practice, receive feedback, and improve over several weeks.

The video library has a clear advantage because graduates can watch it at any time. However, recorded advice cannot answer a follow-up question or help someone notice a weak interview response. The company panel could be inspiring, especially if the speakers share real career stories, but it lasts only one day and may offer limited speaking time for each participant.

I would ask mentors to prepare a simple topic for every meeting, such as introducing yourself, describing a project, or asking questions at the end of an interview. With that structure, the activity would be practical and manageable. Overall, mentoring seems the most useful option because it combines guidance, conversation, and repeated practice.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – chọn giải pháp:**
- Ghi nhanh tiêu chí **personal feedback, access, duration** trong thời gian chuẩn bị.
- Nêu lựa chọn đầu bài, phân tích ưu điểm hai phương án khác rồi giải thích vì sao phương án đã chọn tốt hơn.
- Dùng ví dụ sinh viên ứng tuyển vị trí cụ thể để làm rõ nhu cầu cá nhân.
- Kết thúc bằng một đề xuất triển khai khả thi cho phương án thắng.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Making Summer Streets More Comfortable
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2 problem-solving practice. A neighborhood committee has enough money for only one project this summer. Which option should it choose?
Option A: build shaded seating at two busy bus stops.
Option B: install an additional public drinking-water fountain in the park.
Option C: organize three free evening outdoor events.
Compare the benefits and limitations of the options, then defend one choice.
sample_answer:
I would recommend shaded seating at the two busy bus stops. My main reason is that people use these stops on ordinary working days, including students, older residents, and commuters who may have to wait outside in hot weather. A roof and some benches would make that wait more comfortable. If the design leaves enough space for people using wheelchairs or pushing strollers, it could also improve access.

The drinking-water fountain is another practical idea. It could help people visiting the park, but it would serve only one location, and the committee would need a plan for maintenance. The evening events might bring neighbors together and make the area livelier. However, the benefit would be limited to three occasions, and organizers would still need suitable weather.

For the bus stops, I would start by observing when each stop is busiest and asking passengers where seating would be most useful. I would also choose materials that are easy to clean. In my view, shaded seating provides a daily benefit to a broad group of residents, which makes it the strongest investment for this summer.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – cân nhắc ngân sách cộng đồng:**
- Tiêu chí so sánh là **tần suất sử dụng**, **nhóm hưởng lợi**, **bảo trì**.
- Không phủ nhận sạch trơn hai lựa chọn còn lại; nêu lợi ích rồi chỉ ra giới hạn.
- Ví dụ cụ thể hóa tác động của mái che với người chờ xe.
- Kết luận gắn với điều kiện **only one project this summer**.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Responsible AI Use in Workplace Communication
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3 topic-development practice. Develop a connected talk on this topic:

**AI tools can help employees communicate, but responsible use requires care.**

Discuss these ideas:
- possible benefits for drafting and translating routine messages
- the importance of checking accuracy and protecting private information
- skills employees still need when using AI assistance

Add at least one practical workplace example and conclude with your own viewpoint.
sample_answer:
I believe AI tools can make workplace communication easier, especially when employees need to draft routine messages or work with colleagues who speak different languages. For instance, a support worker might use a tool to create a first draft of an appointment reminder. A team member could also ask for a simpler version of a technical explanation before sharing it with customers. These uses can save time and help people express ideas more clearly.

However, there are important responsibilities. AI-generated text can contain inaccurate details, so employees should check names, dates, prices, and commitments against reliable information. They must also follow their organization's rules for handling private data. If a message contains a customer's personal information, it may need to be handled through an approved system rather than pasted into an unfamiliar tool. The employee sending the message remains responsible for what it says.

Another point is that communication skills still matter. People need to understand the audience, ask useful questions, and decide whether the tone is suitable. For example, imagine that a delivery is delayed. An AI tool may help draft an apology, but a staff member should confirm the actual reason, explain the revised delivery time, and offer the customer an appropriate next step. A generic message would not be enough.

In my view, the best approach is to treat AI as a helpful assistant while keeping human judgment central. With clear workplace guidelines and regular review, teams can enjoy the benefits of faster drafting while maintaining accuracy, privacy, and trust.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – phát triển chủ đề có lập luận:**
- Dàn ý 60 giây theo **benefits → responsibilities → human skills → conclusion**.
- Mỗi luận điểm phải có lý do hoặc ví dụ, nhất là tình huống thông báo giao hàng trễ.
- Dùng cấu trúc **however**, **another point**, **for example**, **in my view** để liên kết ý.
- Tránh khẳng định AI luôn chính xác; nhấn mạnh kiểm chứng thông tin, dữ liệu cá nhân và trách nhiệm của người gửi.
